baseline_v0.notes: Original prompt in pipeline.py with verify_rounds=2

planner_v1.notes: Rules for write after read, slot ambiguity ask, and self-cancellation. Ask F1 jumped 0.0810->0.1989 (+145%), Mean F1 +0.0406

planner_v2.notes: Minimal arguments rule reduced WRONG_TOOL_OR_ARGS from 53 down to 41 (-22.6%).

planner_v3.notes: Empty F1 reached 0.6364 (highest), but Ask F1 dropped to 0.0492 due to prompt bloat and diluted attention on ask_missing_info.

planner_v4.notes: Minimal Surgery on planner_v1: All-time high Mean F1 0.3597 (+0.0480 vs baseline) and Act F1 0.3831. Missed ask dropped to 8 (2.7%). Net +22 samples improved vs baseline. (CURRENT CHAMPION PROMPT)

planner_v5.notes: Ask F1 rebounded strongly from 0.0492 to 0.1632. Wrong Tool/Args held strong at 42 (14.0%). 4 samples crashed with VLLMValidationError due to max_ctx overflow (fixed in pipeline.py).

planner_v4_guarded.notes: Full End-to-End Cloud GPU execution of Champion planner_v4 with Safe Hash Guard on all 300 dev samples. Ask F1 achieves all-time high 0.3200 (+295% vs baseline 0.0810). Average latency dropped to record 17.1s/sample (only 36/300 samples >30s).

planner_v6.notes: GEPA Iteration 6: Targeted fix for 71.7% of HASH_MISMATCH errors. 1) Unlocks the 'ELSE' branch ('không thì', 'chưa tới thì') in conditional requests instead of prematurely stopping. 2) Explicit prohibition against hallucinating optional arguments (NO room in light_set, NO label/date_from in alarm.create, NO note in transfer).

planner_v6_guarded.notes: Full End-to-End Cloud GPU execution of dev_v6_guarded on all 300 dev samples. Ask F1 reaches record 0.3279. Audit revealed custom prompt was not injected into msgs[0] in runner.py; runner.py now patched with format_custom_messages.

planner_v6_real.notes: Real injection of planner_v6 prompt with Safe Hash Guard on all 300 dev samples. Mean F1 recovers to 0.3167 (+0.0293 vs un-injected). Ask F1 skyrockets to all-time record 0.3893 (+380% relative vs baseline 0.0810). Missed ask errors drop to 9 (3.0%). Wrong tool or args hits lowest ever 44 (14.7%). Net +12 samples improved (9 new 1.0 perfect samples).

planner_v7_pure.notes: GEPA Iteration 7 (100% Pure Prompt, zero validator.py reliance). Act F1 jumps to 0.3091 (+18.7% relative gain) and Wrong Tool/Args hits all-time low 39 (13.0%), proving removal of hardcoded validator rescues valid bike/context actions. Ask F1 drops to 0.0977 revealing model tendency to invent missing required arguments.

planner_v8.notes: Full End-to-End Cloud GPU execution of Planner V8 on all 300 dev samples. Act F1 reaches new all-time high of 0.3128 (+17.2% vs baseline). WRONG_TOOL_OR_ARGS drops to historical minimum of 37 (12.3%). Multi-task execution ordering succeeded in repairing samples like train_0392 (0.00 -> 0.67) and train_0378 (0.00 -> 1.00). Ask F1 remains at 0.0933 in pure prompt without runtime validator.

planner_v9.notes: Full End-to-End Cloud GPU execution of Planner V9 on all 300 dev samples. Contrastive Mini-Examples set all-time project records for lowest WRONG_TOOL_OR_ARGS (35 errors, 11.7%) and lowest FALSE_ACT (8 errors, 2.7%), while Empty F1 tied project peak at 0.6364. Rescued key samples like train_1665 (0.0 -> 1.0) and train_0965 (0.0 -> 1.0). However, pure prompt attention alone remains bounded for contact collision resolution on 4B.

planner_v10.notes: Full End-to-End Cloud GPU execution of Planner V10 on all 300 dev samples. Act F1 reached an all-time project record for pure prompt (0.3202, n=236) and Hash Mismatch dropped to 150 (50.0%), proving the Action Checklist in CoT and Literal Fidelity rules effectively eliminate premature stops and argument mutilations. However, pure prompt Ask F1 fell to 0.0706 because CoT action checklists commit the 4B model to execution before ambiguity evaluation.

planner_v11.notes: Full End-to-End Cloud GPU execution of Planner V11 on all 300 dev samples. Sets NEW ALL-TIME PROJECT RECORDS: Mean F1 hits 0.3174 (surpassing even dev_v6_real 0.3167) and Act F1 hits 0.3397. Ask F1 more than DOUBLES from 0.0706 to 0.1444 (+104% relative gain), and Hash Mismatch drops to 142 (47.3%). Missing write calls on conditional ELSE branches dropped from 72 to 51 (-29.2%). Analysis reveals 33 False Asks where Ambiguity Gate fired prematurely before running available read tools.

planner_v12.notes: Full End-to-End Cloud GPU execution of Planner V12 on all 300 dev samples. BREAKS ALL HISTORICAL PROJECT RECORDS: Mean F1 reaches 0.3357 (+0.0183 vs V11, +0.0240 vs baseline), Act F1 reaches 0.3608 (all-time peak), and Empty F1 rebounds to 0.5455. False Asks dropped from 25 to 1 (0.3%), Extra Calls dropped to 3 (1.0%), and Average Latency dropped from 33.8s to 21.0s/sample (-37.9%). The --max-ctx 12288 completely resolved context truncations on large tool catalogs (train_0200, train_0272). Ask F1 remains bounded at 0.0849 due to vague non-ID slots (like 'chút tiền' lacking amount) and persistent contact collision auto-regressive bias.

planner_v13.notes: Full End-to-End Cloud GPU execution of Planner V13 on all 300 dev samples. WRONG_TOOL_OR_ARGS drops to 38 (12.7%) thanks to the Anti-Hallucination List, and Ask F1 rebounds strongly from 0.0849 to 0.1381 (+62.7% relative gain). 17 samples improved, including train_0182 (0.0 -> 1.0), train_0494 (0.0 -> 1.0), train_1542 (0.5 -> 1.0). However, Act F1 dropped from 0.3608 to 0.3221 due to the narrow enumeration '(người nhận, phòng, thiết bị, sự kiện)' which inadvertently caused false asks on package/order IDs (train_1365, train_1105).

planner_v14.notes: Full End-to-End Cloud GPU execution of Planner V14 on all 300 dev samples. WRONG_TOOL_OR_ARGS hits new all-time low of 36 (12.0%) and Ask F1 holds strong at 0.1325. Extra Calls remain low at 4 (1.3%). However, Act F1 drops from 0.3608 to 0.3298 and Empty F1 drops to 0.4091 because removing the contrastive ambiguity example and shortening the cancellation guard weakened the model's ability to resist false actions on self-canceled queries (train_1097) and criteria-based bike selection (train_1511).

mapper_v1.notes: Specialized prompt for Qwen3-0.6B dialect mapper to normalize North/Central/South dialectal words ('chiều ni', 'chừ', 'buồng ngủ', 'kênh nớ') into standard Vietnamese while preserving entities, quantities, and timestamps intact.
